notes: No explicit marker exists, and neither slot has ever been activated (lastPlayedAt nil for both), so `slots.filter({ $0.lastPlayedAt != nil }).max(by:)` (lines 137-139) filters down to an empty array and returns nil. Resolution falls all the way through to the last-resort branch, `slots.max(by: { $0.createdAt < $1.createdAt })` (line 143), which picks slot-b as the newest-created. This is the state a fresh, never-activated set of slots is in immediately after import.
